title: Protective Effect of Flavonoids against Methylglyoxal-Induced Oxidative Stress in PC-12 Neuroblastoma Cells and Its Structure-Activity Relationships.
authors: Zhang, Danyang; Li, Xia; He, Xiaoshi; Xing, Yan; Jiang, Bo; Xiu, Zhilong; Bao, Yongming; Dong, Yuesheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物对甲基乙二醛诱导PC-12细胞氧化应激的保护作用及构效关系，涉及Keap1-Nrf2分子对接，但核心为小分子-蛋白互作与细胞实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Methylglyoxal-induced oxidative stress and cytotoxicity are the main factors causing neuronal death-related, diabetically induced memory impairment. Antioxidant and anti-apoptotic therapy are potential intervention strategies. In this study, 25 flavonoids with different substructures were assayed for protecting PC-12 cells from methylglyoxal-induced damage. A structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis indicated that the absence of the double bond at C-2 and C-3, substitutions of the gallate group at the 3 position, the pyrogallol group at the B-ring, and the R configuration of the 3 position enhanced the protection of flavan-3-ols, and a hydroxyl substitution at the 4' and meta-positions were important for the protection of flavonol. These SARs were further confirmed by molecular docking using the active site of the Keap1-Nrf2 complex as the receptor. The mechanistic study demonstrated that EGCG with the lowest EC(50) protected the PC-12 cells from methylglyoxal-induced damage by reducing oxidative stress via the Nrf2/Keap1/HO-1 and Bcl-2/Bax signaling pathways. These results suggested that flavan-3-ols might be a potential dietary supplement for protection against diabetic encephalopathy.
abstract_zh: 甲基乙二醛诱导的氧化应激和细胞毒性是导致神经元死亡相关、糖尿病诱导的记忆障碍的主要因素。抗氧化和抗凋亡治疗是潜在的干预策略。本研究评估了25种具有不同亚结构的黄酮类化合物对PC-12细胞免受甲基乙二醛诱导损伤的保护作用。构效关系（SAR）分析表明，C-2和C-3位双键的缺失、3位没食子酰基的取代、B环上邻苯三酚基团以及3位的R构型增强了黄烷-3-醇的保护作用，而4'位和间位羟基取代对黄酮醇的保护至关重要。这些SAR通过使用Keap1-Nrf2复合物的活性位点作为受体的分子对接进一步得到证实。机制研究表明，具有最低EC(50)的表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）通过Nrf2/Keap1/HO-1和Bcl-2/Bax信号通路减少氧化应激，从而保护PC-12细胞免受甲基乙二醛诱导的损伤。这些结果表明，黄烷-3-醇可能作为预防糖尿病脑病的潜在膳食补充剂。
